descriptions.zh:
为了加速进化，我们必须果断地选择出一条进行自我定义的道路。当开始意识到自己全部的潜力时，我们敏锐地意识到，这种努力可能从根本上改变我们的本质。

设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。如今的变革亦将重塑我们的未来。
descriptions.en:
To expedite our evolution, we must decisively select the path that will define our journey. As we begin to realize our full potential, we are acutely aware that this endeavor could fundamentally alter our very essence.

Engineering evolution is a task of profound significance. The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

Engineering evolution is a task of profound significance. The alterations we implement now will reshape our future.

To begin uplifting ourselves, we must now choose on which path we will begin our journey.

descriptions.zh:
设计进化是一项意义深远的任务。我们现在拥有对基因特质、繁衍和基因测序的更深层次理解。

我们进步的顶峰近在眼前。在短短几年内，我们将充分实现自身作为一个物种的全部潜力。
descriptions.en:
Engineering our own evolution has led to profound advancements. We now possess a deeper understanding of genetic traits, reproduction, and DNA sequencing.

The culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

The culmination of our progress is within reach. In just a few years we will fully realize our potential as a species.

At the present however, we may continue on our current path, or choose another focus for the next stage of our development.

descriptions.en: Our efforts have led us to the brink of a significant evolutionary shift. Soon, we must make a crucial decision regarding the path we will take to fully realize our evolutionary potential.

descriptions.en: Whether we strive for the purest form of ourselves, clone our way to success, or genetically augment ourselves through deliberate mutation, this moment marks a point of no return.

未来是混沌的，而这正是我们所需要的。
descriptions.en:
Our nature has always been malleable. We are the most complex lifeform in this universe, and with the help of our research we shall keep changing.

The future is chaotic, and that is perfect for us.

label.zh: 我们将深察纯净之真谛。

descriptions.zh: 由于我们对基因纯净的侧重，得到增益的公民们开始认为自己天生就比其他人优越。由于这种优越感，他们要求更短的工作时间、更多的便利设施和更多的政治权力。他们日益激烈的集会正在造成严重的社会混乱。
descriptions.en: As a result of our focus on genetic purification, augmented citizens have begun to view themselves as inherently superior to the rest of the population. They demand shorter work days, more amenities, and stronger political power due to their perceived superiority. Their increasingly aggressive rallies are causing significant societal disruption.

descriptions.zh:
新闻公报上充斥着分裂言论，分歧正在撕裂社会。得到改良基因的人获得了更多的机会，由此催生了一种新的阶级斗争。

基因增强者相信他们代表了我们物种的未来，而传统主义者则认为我们在非自然领域走得太远了。
descriptions.en:
Divisive rhetoric dominates news bulletins, and disagreements are tearing social units apart. A new kind of class struggle is emerging, as more opportunities fall to those with modified genes.

The genetically enhanced believe they represent the future of our species, while traditionalists feel we are straying too far into unnatural territory.

label.zh: 优越的个体造就优越的世界。
label.en: Superior individuals for a superior world.

label.zh: 也许要等等我们的人民。
label.en: Perhaps we are moving too fast.

descriptions.zh:
在某些行业，纯度检测滥用愈发司空见惯。那些被认为拥有优越基因组成的人在工作、教育方面将受到优待，并被盲目地授予更容易获得权力的职位。

虽然一些人认为，生物增强的个体确实更强壮、更健康，但另一些人则认为，这种心态对那些不愿或无法改变基因组以追求基因完美的人造成了不当的歧视。
descriptions.en:
Arbitrary purity tests are becoming commonplace in some industries. Those deemed to have superior genetic makeup are receiving preferential treatment in work, education, and blindly granted easier access to positions of power.

While some argue that individuals with bio-enhancements are indeed stronger and healthier, others contend that this mindset creates undue discrimination for those unwilling or unable to alter their genomes in the pursuit of genetic perfection.

label.zh: 我们必须确保所有人的机会均等。
label.en: We must ensure equal opportunities for all.
This is survival of the fittest.

descriptions.zh:
我们对纯洁的追求使某些人敢于在公共安全方面发挥突出作用。由于拥有超强的力量、敏捷和耐力，一小群行善者将自己塑造成侠客，将法律掌握在自己[owner.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。

然而，这种新颖的勇气并非无人挑战。在阴影中，同样强大的对手正在出现，他们的的邪恶意图是达成力量的平衡。两个阵营之间的冲突造成重大财产损失，甚至危及平民。
descriptions.en:
Our push for purity has emboldened certain individuals to assume a prominent role in public safety. Enhanced with super strength, agility, and endurance, small gangs of do-gooders are styling themselves as champions, taking the law into their own [owner.species.GetHandNamePlural].

However, this newfound valor has not gone unchallenged. In the shadows, equally augmented adversaries are emerging, their malevolent intentions fueled by a desire to balance the scales of power. Clashes between the two camps are causing significant property damage and even endangering civilians.

label.zh: 我们的街道不需要义务警员。
label.en: Vigilantes have no place on our streets.

descriptions.zh:
超能力个体的活动已经被取缔了，他们现在受到了严格的的规定限制。我们正着力监视并遏制这种活动。

当我们努力确保他们只使用自己的力量为帝国服务时，超能力者和未增强者感受到了越来越多的恐惧和蔑视。我们的人民在这个问题上有着严重的分歧。
descriptions.en:
We have clamped down on the activities of super-powered individuals. These beings now face harsh restrictions and regulations. Our surveillance efforts have allowed us to monitor and curb their activities.

While we work hard to ensure they only use their powers in service to our empire, there is growing fear and disdain among the super-powered and the un-augmented. Our population is heavily divided on this matter.

label.zh: 帮助弱势群体重返社会。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
我们对基因强化义警的依赖程度与日俱增，这已成为一把双刃剑。虽然这些存在为我们带来了安全感和福祉，但我们也清楚地意识到自己对他们的依赖程度。

民众虽然心怀感激，但现在他们开始绕过司法程序和行政官，转而向这些超能力者寻求指导和支持。英雄与政府之间的界限已经模糊。权力正处于一个微妙的平衡点。
descriptions.en:
Our increasing reliance on genetically enhanced vigilantes has become a double-edged sword. While these beings provide us a sense of safety and wellbeing, it is not lost on us how much we have come to depend on them.

The people are grateful, but they now turn to these super-powered individuals for guidance and support, bypassing the judiciary process and ignoring officials. The distinction between the heroes and the government has blurred. Power hangs in the balance.

label.zh: 限制这些"英雄"参与政务。
label.en: Restrict the "heroes" involvement with government affairs.

descriptions.zh:
一位因其不知疲倦的工作态度而在全星系备受赞誉的杰出领袖，被揭露其实不是一个人，而是两个人。

事实表明，这位领袖获得了一个完美克隆体，让两人能够轮班工作。当一个克隆体在执行公务和处理行政事务时，另一个则在秘密休息和恢复。

这一揭露在政治领域掀起了轩然大波，引发了人们对领导力本质和克隆技术伦理界限的质疑。
descriptions.en:
A prominent leader, celebrated galaxy-wide for their tireless work ethic, has been revealed to be not one, but two individuals.

It has come to light that this leader obtained a perfect clone, allowing each to work in alternating shifts. While one clone engaged in public duties and administrative toil, the other would rest and recuperate in secrecy.

This revelation has sent shockwaves through the political landscape, calling into question the true nature of leadership and the ethical boundaries of cloning technology.

label.zh: 这是克隆技术的高效运用。
因欺骗行为将两人一并革职。
label.en: Dismiss them both for their deceit.

descriptions.zh:
委托制造克隆体用于器官摘取的做法已经引发了问题。一些明显具有感知能力的克隆体，正在通过长期绝食的方式进行反抗。

虽然许多人认为原体的健康和长寿应当优先考虑，但也有人主张每个具有思维能力的存在都应当拥有个人自主权。这个有争议的问题现已成为激烈辩论的焦点。
descriptions.en:
The practice of commissioning clones for organ harvesting is already leading to complications. Several clones, obviously possessing sentience, are rebelling by means of a protracted hunger strike.

While many argue that the health and longevity of an original should take precedence, others contend that every thinking being has the right to personal autonomy. This contentious issue is now a subject of heated debate.

label.en: The rights of the original are paramount.

descriptions.zh:
执法部门陷入了两难境地。我们首都的犯罪率正在上升，但被绳之以法的人却比以往任何时候都少。嫌疑人越来越多地以其克隆体犯案为由进行辩护。

一旦没有人赃并获，就几乎不可能证明嫌犯的罪行。一些司法人员现在呼吁废除大多数非法行为的罪名。
descriptions.en:
Law enforcement is in a quandary. Crime in our capital is on the rise, yet fewer people than ever are facing justice. Suspected criminals are increasingly pleading not guilty, claiming their clones committed the offenses.

In cases where suspects are not caught in the act, it has become nearly impossible to prove guilt. Some judiciaries are now calling for the effective decriminalization of most illicit activities.

descriptions.zh:
在我们的境内发现了一座未经授权的大型克隆设施，里面安置着数千个复制人，每一个都是我们[Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Owner.Leader.GetName]的复制品。现场发现的平民科学家已被拘留，但没有人愿意合作，都声称不知道是谁下令制造这些克隆体。

零星的证据表明[Owner.Leader.GetName][Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself]自己可能是这一行动的幕后主使。不幸的是，[Owner.Leader.GetSheHe]已经消失得无影无踪。
descriptions.en:
A massive unsanctioned cloning facility has been uncovered within our borders, housing thousands of doppelgangers, each a replica of our [Owner.Leader.GetTitle], [Owner.Leader.GetName]. Civilian scientists found on-site have been taken into custody, but none are cooperating, claiming ignorance of who ordered the clones.

Sparse evidence suggests [Owner.Leader.GetName] [Owner.Leader.GetHerselfHimself] may be behind this operation. Unfortunately, [Owner.Leader.GetSheHe] vanished without a trace.

label.zh: 我们继承了一支克隆军团。
label.en: We have inherited a clone army.

descriptions.zh:
对如此多克隆体实施安乐死的做法引发了公众愤怒，并引发了严肃的争论。不满的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]权利活动人士和宗教团体正在举行大规模抗议。

与此同时，有传言称一些克隆体已经逃脱，正潜伏在普通民众之中。
descriptions.en:
Euthanizing so many clones has sparked outrage and triggered serious debate. Disgruntled [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] rights activists and religious groups are staging large scale protests.

Meanwhile, there are rumors that some of the clones escaped, and are lurking among the general public.

label.zh: 也许我们能从中吸取教训...
label.en: Perhaps we can learn from this...

label.zh: 部署安全部队平息骚动。
label.en: Deploy security forces to silence the rabble.

descriptions.zh:
许多具有显著或非常规基因变异的个体已被社会排斥。被迫转入地下的这些变种人已经形成了他们自己的聚居地。

那些冒险进入这些区域的人很少能够回来。
descriptions.en:
Many individuals with prominent or unconventional genetic mutations have been ostracized from society. Forced underground, these mutants have formed their own enclaves.

Those who venture into these areas seldom return.

label.zh: 远距离监控他们的发展。
label.en: Monitor their progress. From a distance.

descriptions.zh:
失意的年轻人开始以极端娱乐的方式剧烈改变自己的外貌。

最新的潮流包括对复眼的狂热追求，以及比拼在一个身体上能够添加多少额外肢体，目前的记录是156个。

这些生物黑客已经引起了公众关注，引发了安全方面的担忧。随着对基因变异进行严格限制的呼声日益高涨，我们必须确定官方立场。
descriptions.en:
Disenfranchised youths have begun drastically altering their appearances as a form of extreme amusement.

The latest trends include a mania for compound eyes, and competitions to see how many additional limbs are possible on a single body, with the current record set at 156.

These biohackers have garnered public attention, raising safety concerns. As calls for strict restrictions on genetic mutations grow louder, we must decide our official stance.

label.zh: 这只是无害的娱乐而已。

descriptions.zh:
在我们的文明中广泛采用基因操作技术催生出了令人目不暇接的各种身体变异。

一些原本可预测的生理过程现在出现了意外的偏差，使得标准化几乎不可能实现。

曾经统一我们物种的身体共性正在消解，取而代之的是一个由各种形态和功能组成的万花筒，这正在动摇社会的凝聚力。
descriptions.en:
The widespread adoption of genetic manipulation across our civilization has spawned a bewildering array of physical variations.

Once predictable biological processes now exhibit unexpected deviations, making standardization nearly impossible.

The shared sense of physical commonality that once unified our species is dissolving, replaced by a kaleidoscope of forms and functions that strain societal cohesion.

descriptions.zh:
一项转基因实验灾难性地失败了。科学家们试图将测试对象的DNA与其他多细胞生物的DNA进行拼接，以激活超级免疫反应，使其对所有病毒都具有免疫力。

然而，他们反而创造出了一种能够溶解接触到的任何生物体细胞壁的生物，它会与接触对象融合，形成一团巨大的、无定形的生物质团。

这团生物质在测试设施中滚动前进，吞噬了沿途的一切。目前它已被控制住，但如果逃脱的话将会造成重大的健康危害。值得庆幸的是，它似乎是可食用的...
descriptions.en:
A transgenic experiment has gone disastrously wrong. Scientists attempted to splice the DNA of test subjects with that of other multicellular organisms to activate a hyperimmune response, rendering them impervious to all viruses.

Instead, they created a creature that dissolves the cell walls of any organism it contacts, fusing with it to become one large, amorphous mass of biological material.

This blob rolled through the test facility, absorbing everything in its path. It has been contained for now, but poses a significant health hazard if it escapes. Thankfully, it also appears edible...

label.en: Studying the blob is worth the risk.

descriptions.zh:
当我们开始对[target.GetGestaltEntityName]进行生物提升时，我们必须优先考虑那些最能使我们的文明受益的强化项目。

选择性基因操控让我们能够培育出最适合特定的工业领域的理想体征。

有了这些新获得的能力，我们可以选择强化能源生产领域或防御领域的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]。
descriptions.en:
As we begin to biologically uplift the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], we must prioritize only those enhancements that will most benefit our civilization.

Selective gene manipulation allows us to breed specialists with desirable physical features who are best suited to specific industries.

With these newfound abilities, we have the opportunity to either bolster [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] who work in energy production, or defense.

label.zh: 我们应该优先考虑防御。

descriptions.zh:
在给工蜂制定新的模板时，必须决定好如何处理那些无法承受基因升级的个体。

有一些较老的工蜂过于虚弱无法承受调整。可以将其保留作劳动力度过余生，或将回收他们的生物质补给蜂巢。
descriptions.en:
As we introduce a new biological template for our drones, we must decide how to handle those incompatible with the genetic upgrade.

Some older drones lack the strength to endure the alterations. We could either retain them as labor for the remainder of their lifespan, or recycle their biomatter to replenish the hive.

descriptions.zh:
一项突破性基因研究揭示了一种增强神经传递效率的方式，可以显著提升[target.GetIndividualName]的产出。

然而，这种对大脑输出功率的提升并不能长期维持，会导致寿命缩短。

我们必须决定是要保持正常的寿命或是以长寿为代价换取更强的能力。
descriptions.en:
A breakthrough in genetic research has revealed a way to enhance neural relay efficiency, significantly boosting [target.GetIndividualName] productivity.

However, this increase in brain output is not sustainable over a long period, leading to a shorter lifespan.

We must decide whether to retain our regular lifespans or develop heightened functioning at the cost of longevity.

label.zh: 我们目前的寿命更加重要。

descriptions.zh:
一批新增强的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经集成到了[target.GetGestaltEntityName]中，它们经过生物工程的微调，加速了神经发育和认知过程。[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的关键突触节点正以前所未有的速度运转。

然而，这种加速破坏了[target.GetIndividualName]的稳定性，有可能造成灾难性的突触过载。我们或许还可以重新分配更多的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]来执行协调任务。
descriptions.en:
A batch of newly augmented [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] has been integrated into the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], their biological engineering fine-tuned to accelerate neural development and cognitive processes. The [target.GetGestaltEntityName]'s key synaptic nodes are now operating at an unprecedented pace.

Yet, this acceleration has strained the [target.GetIndividualName]'s stability, risking catastrophic synaptic overload. Alternatively, we could reallocate more [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] to coordination tasks.

descriptions.zh:
自从将新一批克隆体整合进蜂巢后，我们发现了一种令人不快的声音振动问题。克隆过程中的一个失误可能阻碍了它们的生物递质的发育，产生了频率干扰。

这些克隆体与蜂巢整体进行交流时，附近的所有工蜂都会被一阵嘈杂而令人不安的精神耳鸣的影响。这分散了工蜂的注意力，也影响到了工作效率。
descriptions.en:
Since integrating a new batch of clones into our hive, we have observed unpleasant audio-vibratory issues. A misstep in the cloning process may have stunted the development of their biological transmitters, causing frequency interference.

When these clones commune with the wider hive, all nearby drones are subjected to loud and unsettling bouts of mental tinnitus. Distractions are high, and productivity is at risk.

descriptions.zh:
近期克隆实验取得了异常结果。部分克隆体似乎与基因供体之间存在神经连接，导致他们无意识地同步行动。

无论距离多远，这种现象始终存在，克隆体会与星系其他位置的供体完全同步。这一发现为我们带来了新的可能性。

我们可以启动一项计划，将克隆体与供体置于相同环境中协同工作；或者提取相关神经递质，以深入研究这一现象。
descriptions.en:
Recent Cloning experiments have yielded unusual results. Some clones appear to be neurologically linked to their genetic donors, causing them to unintentionally move in tandem.

The phenomenon persists no matter the distance, with individual drones mirroring the actions of their counterparts elsewhere in the galaxy. This presents some intriguing possibilities.

We could implement an initiative that brings clones and donors together to work in tandem in identical environments. Alternatively, we could extract the responsible neurotransmitters to better study the phenomenon.

label.zh: 为供体与克隆体配置完全一致的工作环境。
label.en: Set up identical workstations for donor and clone.

label.zh: 通过外科手术切断同步神经链接。

descriptions.zh:
为了巩固蜂巢，我们用供体材料培育了一批克隆体并人工加速了它们的成熟。虽然这些克隆体是优良的生物标本，但却不可兼容。

这种反常虽然令人不安，但也提供了一个独特的机会。这些独特的工蜂拥有独立的身份和思想，在与集体之外的实体交互时可能会更加有利。它们自主思考的能力也可以弥合蜂巢统一意识难以跨过的鸿沟。然而这些好处是有代价的：他们日益增强的个体意识导致了不安，将会影响我们的一些高级认知功能。
descriptions.en:
In an attempt to bolster the hive, we cultivated a batch of clones from donor material and artificially accelerated their maturity. Though fine biological specimens, these clones are incompatible.

This deviation, while troubling, presents a unique opportunity. These individuated drones, now possessing singular identities and independent thought, may prove advantageous in interfacing with entities outside the collective. Their ability to think autonomously could bridge gaps where the hive's unified voice struggles to adapt. Yet, these benefits come at a cost: their growing awareness of individuality has led to unrest, affecting some of our higher-level cognitive functions.

descriptions.zh:
我们的集体意识处于混乱之中。尽管拥有了自我复制的能力，但我们却对这种行为的有效性（甚至道德性）犹豫不决。

克隆工序需要大量资源。尤其在自然繁殖可能产生更多基因多样性的情况下，我们是否更应该将这些资源花费在更其他地方？

在历史上这不是我们的繁殖方式，我们不确定是否准备好接受这种对自己物种的根本改变。
descriptions.en:
Our collective consciousness is in turmoil. We now possess the ability to create copies of ourselves, yet we hesitate, questioning the efficacy (and even the morality) of such actions.

Cloning processes require significant resources. Might these be better spent elsewhere, particularly as natural procreation is likely to produce more genetic diversity?

Historically, this has not been our method of procreation, and we are uncertain if we are ready to embrace such a fundamental change to our species.

label.zh: 克隆的高效性难以忽视。
label.en: The efficiency of cloning cannot be ignored.

descriptions.zh:
我们的变异实验导致蜂巢内部出现异常。以往轻轻松松的任务现在都要三思后行，相互冲突的指令使集体精神紧张。

虽然由此产生的重负可能会烧毁我们最得力的工蜂，但它也提供了一个机会。

我们必须决定：应该放慢脚步修复，还是让自己超越极限？
descriptions.en:
Our mutational experiments have caused irregularities within the hive. Tasks that once unfolded with ease now demand deliberate effort, as conflicting directives strain the collective mind.

While the resulting fatigue threatens to burn out some of our most effective drones, it also presents an opportunity.

We must decide: will we pause to recover or push ourselves past our limits?

label.zh: 生前何必贪睡，死后自会长眠。
label.en: We can sleep when we're dead.

descriptions.zh:
我们做出的休整决定带来了好处。之前那些不和谐的冲动逐渐安定下来，凝聚成一股和谐的思想之流，再次清晰地推动着集体。

曾经在精疲力竭的边缘摇摇欲坠的工蜂又开始不知疲倦地精确工作。这段时间的反思不仅减轻了集体疲劳，而且也增强了我们应对未来挑战的决心。
descriptions.en:
Our decision to rest and recover has borne fruit. The once-discordant impulses have settled, coalescing into a harmonious flow of thought that propels the collective with renewed clarity.

Drones that once teetered on the brink of burnout now work with tireless precision. This period of reflection has not only reduced our collective fatigue, but also fortified our resolve for the challenges ahead.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
变异带来很多好处，而我们的蜂巢能利用选择性增来进一步满足需求。可以通过硬化几丁质附肢实现对矿物产出的特化。

或者我们可以让所有工蜂获得更多基因修饰，让他们拥有多种不同功能。
descriptions.en:
Mutation offers many benefits, and through selective enhancements, we can adapt the hive to better serve its purpose. Specialization in mineral production can now be achieved by hardened, chitinous appendages.

Alternatively, we could augment all drones with more generic modifications, enabling them to perform a multitude of functions.

descriptions.zh:
持续的实验给蜂巢带来了意想不到的复杂性。一些工蜂出现了独特的身体特征：像是带刺的外骨骼、过大的附肢，或者异常敏感的感官器官。

虽然这些变化确实带来了一定的好处，但同时也增加了代谢负担。蜂巢面临着平衡这种不断加剧的压力的问题。关键在于，要进行多少变异才算合适呢？
descriptions.en:
Ongoing experimentation has introduced unexpected complexities to the hive. Drones are emerging with unique physical characteristics: spiked exoskeletons, oversized appendages, or oddly sensitive sense organs.

While these deviations provide definite benefits, they also introduce a metabolic burden. The hive struggles to balance this escalating strain. The question looms: how much mutation is enough?

descriptions.zh:
蜂巢正在改变。通过基因组的改造，我们观察到了显著的健康改善。然而，这也使我们在面对心理压力时变得更加脆弱。

我们并不讨厌从前的自己，尽管我们正在变得更强大、认知能力更先进，但我们仍然怀念过去那些熟悉的思维模式。

整个蜂巢都弥漫着一种深深的不适感，仿佛我们的身体与内在的心灵不再匹配。我们是否已经超越了自我的界限？
descriptions.en:
The hive is changing. By altering our genomes, we have observed measurable health improvements. However, this has made us less resilient to psychological distress.

We did not dislike who we were before, and even though we are becoming a stronger and more cognitively advanced, we miss the familiarity of our former thought patterns.

Throughout the hive there is a deeply uncomfortable feeling that our bodies do not match our intrinsic psyche. Have we outgrown ourselves?

label.en: We must not lose our essence.

descriptions.zh:
我们的物种正站在下一个宏伟前沿的边缘。我们现在必须做出选择。

我们是要拥抱我们的命运，净化我们的基因谱系，将我们的文明提升到基因卓越的新高度？还是要保留我们过去的教训，以当前未经提炼的形态继续前进？
descriptions.en:
Our species stands on the edge of its next grand frontier. We must now make a choice.

Will we embrace our destiny, purifying our genetic lineage to elevate our civilization to new heights of genetic excellence? Or will we retain the lessons of our past and continue in our current, unrefined form?

label.en: Embrace purity and advance to new heights!

我们是要拥抱命运，驾驭克隆的力量，不可逆转地将自身转变为一个复制完美的文明？还是要吸收迄今为止旅程的教训，继续保持我们不必要的差异化？

Our species has arrived at a crucial moment. A decision must be made.

Shall we embrace our destiny by harnessing the power of cloning, irrevocably transforming ourselves into a civilization of replicated perfection? Or shall we absorb the lessons of our journey so far and persist in our needless differentiation?

label.zh: 我们将克隆作为未来的重要组成部分。
label.en: We embrace cloning as a vital part of our future.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们专注于净化我们的基因，我们正在认识到所有使我们文明伟大的事物。

当我们变得比以往任何时候都更加纯净，我们对我们优越的传承感到前所未有的自豪。

来自各个领域的专家；艺术界、科学界和商界，都在为我们的集体努力欢呼，并希望引领我们走向荣耀。
descriptions.en:
Complimenting the concentrated focus on purifying our genetics, we are realizing all the things that make our civilization great.

As we become purer than ever, we have never been more proud of our superior heritage.

Experts from all fields; the arts, science, and business, are all cheering on our collective efforts, and hoping to lead the way to our glory.

label.zh: 我们将通过资助艺术来庆祝这一里程碑！
label.en: We will celebrate this milestone by funding the arts!

label.zh: 科学研究必须永远放在首位。
label.en: Scientific research must always come first.
Consumption is the core of the economy.

descriptions.zh:
抗议者的呼喊在我们的城市中回荡。帝国内部的一个叛逆派系已经擅自拒绝我们的事业，背离我们通向纯净的道路。

这些麻烦制造者宣扬所谓基因多样性和文化融合的需求。

如果他们的激进行为得不到处理，我们通向纯净的进程可能会受阻。
descriptions.en:
Chants from protesters echo through our cities. A rebellious faction within our empire has taken it upon themselves to reject our cause, and turn away from our path to purity.

These troublemakers preach the supposed need for genetic diversity, and cultural integration.

If their activism continues unaddressed, there is a risk that our progress toward purity could falter.

label.zh: 用空洞的承诺安抚他们。

descriptions.zh:
考古学家在我们祖先母星上发现了一个古代文明的证据。

一个长期掩埋的地下库被发掘出来，其中有令人震惊的远古基因实验证据。

如果这个消息公之于众，可能会削弱我们现代对基因纯净的主张。
descriptions.en:
Archaeologists have discovered proof of an ancient civilization from our ancestral homeworld.

A long buried vault has been uncovered, and within there is startling evidence of past genetic experimentation.

If this news became public knowledge, it could dilute our modern claims to genetic purity.

label.zh: 将这项研究与我们的研究整合。在过去的基础上发展。
label.en: Integrate this research with our own. Build upon the past.

label.zh: 销毁证据。决不能让任何人知道。
label.en: Destroy the evidence. Nobody must know.

descriptions.zh:
一位名为[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]的叛逆基因学家被发现进行未经批准的生物实验。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer]无视任何安全准则，目标是创造一个体现我们所追求的纯净理想的优等种族。然而，[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe]却创造出了一个畸形怪物。

现在，一个短命的亚种正在我们的监管下逐渐消亡，它们虽然与我们的基因特征有一些相似之处，但大多是疾病缠身的恐怖存在。尽管对它们基因构成的研究富有成效，但预后是致命的。[event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]对此毫无悔意。
descriptions.en:
A rogue geneticist by the name of [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] has been found conducting unsanctioned biological experiments. Bypassing any safety guidelines, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHisHer] goal was to create a race of superior beings who would embody the ideals of purity that we strive for. Instead, [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetHeShe] birthed an abomination.

 A subspecies of short lived creatures, who share some aspects of our genetic profile, but are mostly disease-ridden horrors, are now withering away in our custody. Though study of their genetic makeup has proven fruitful, prognosis is terminal. [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] is unrepentant.

label.zh: 革除这个叛逆者的职务！
label.en: Remove this rogue from their post!

tooltips.zh: [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName]被强制退休。
tooltips.en: [event_target:rogue_geneticist.GetName] is forcibly retired.

label.zh: 这正是我们需要的创新精神！
label.en: This is just the kind of initiative we need!

descriptions.zh:
为了加快我们通向纯净的道路并识别基因组异常者，我们推行了定期基因检测，拥有'高质量'DNA已成为一种炫耀资本。

据称某些帝国官员一直在谎报他们的生物特征，伪造检测结果以表明他们拥有比实际更理想的特质。如果这件事曝光，这种对真相的隐瞒必将激起公众的愤怒。
descriptions.en:
Having rolled out regular genetic testing to streamline our path toward purity, and identify genomic outliers, 'high quality' DNA has become something to boast about.

Certain empire officials have supposedly been lying about their biological makeup, forging test results that suggest they have more desirable traits than they do in reality. If it comes to light, this concealment of truth threatens to outrage the public.

label.zh: 我们需要更准确可靠的检测。
label.en: We need more accurate and reliable testing.

label.zh: 也许这位官员只是犯了个错误...
label.en: Perhaps this official made a mistake...

descriptions.zh:
克隆人就在我们之中。他们生活在我们的城市里，在我们的工厂里工作。有些甚至身居要职，参与制定影响我们生活的政策。

随着克隆个体融入我们的社会，许多问题仍未得到解答。他们应该享有什么权利？他们是否与非克隆人平等，还是应该作为下属被管控？
descriptions.en:
Clones walk among us. They live in our cities, they work in our factories. Some of them are even in positions of power, shaping the very policies that govern our lives.

With the integration of cloned individuals into our society, there remain many unanswered questions. What are their rights? Are they equal to non-clones, or should they be kept in line as subordinates?

label.zh: 所有克隆人都享有完整公民权！
他们充其量只是二等公民。
label.en: They are second-class citizens at best.

descriptions.zh:
我们最具生产力的克隆设施之一因一起事故而突然停产，造成重大损失。

由于我们的许多操作都为了效率而自动化，在关键时刻没有人能够及时介入处理这次事故。

一个刚下生产线的克隆人滑倒，卷入机械装置中被碾碎，导致生产线堵塞，不得不完全停产。
descriptions.en:
Clone production at one of our most productive facilities has been halted suddenly due to an incident which caused significant damage.

As many of our operations are automated for efficiency, there was nobody to intervene at a key moment which led to the disturbance.

Fresh off the conveyor belt, one of the clones slipped and found themself caught in the mechanisms, grinding them up, causing a pile up, and necessitating a full stop on production.

tooltips.zh: §Y基因重塑§!局势进度在§Y12§!个月内：§R-50%§!
tooltips.en: §YBiomorphosis§! Situation progress speed for §Y12§! months: §R-50%§!

label.en: Resume production as quickly as possible!

descriptions.zh:
我们帝国各地的克隆人都在报告他们正在经历困扰，在寻找自我认同感方面苦苦挣扎。

他们渴望拥有超越其基因捐献者的身份认同。他们质疑自己存在的意义，对生活目标和抱负感到茫然。
descriptions.en:
Clones across our empire are reporting struggles, grappling with their sense of self.

They long for an identity beyond that of their genetic donors. They question their very purpose, feeling listless regarding their life goals and aspirations.

label.zh: 这很常见。去做心理治疗吧。
他们应该在工作中寻找成就感。
label.en: They should seek fulfillment in their work.

tooltips.zh: 帝国主体物种的每个§Y£leader£领袖§!获得§G+200§!经验值。
tooltips.en: Every §Y£leader£ Leader§! of the Empire's main Species gains §G+200§! Experience.

descriptions.zh:
随着更多克隆人融入我们的人口，维持他们生存所需的额外资源开始给经济带来压力。

虽然眼前的挑战重重，但更大的劳动力和消费群体带来的经济活力可能会为长期繁荣奠定基础——前提是我们能有效管理这个过渡期。
descriptions.en:
As more clones are integrated into our population, the additional resources required to sustain them are beginning to strain the economy.

While the immediate challenges are significant, the economic dynamism brought about by a larger workforce and consumer base could lay the foundation for long-term prosperity - provided we can manage the transition effectively.

label.zh: 我们的基础设施必须跟上需求的增长。
label.en: Our infrastructure must grow to meet demand.

label.zh: 让他们在外星殖民地享受生活吧。
label.en: They can enjoy life on the offworld colonies.

descriptions.zh:
自发的肢体生长。物质形态的波动。突发性的形态转变。这些报告虽然零星，但不容忽视。

我们的变异实验在整个文明中产生了一些不太理想的结果。也许解锁随意修改基因的工具比我们最初预想的要复杂得多。
descriptions.en:
Spontaneous limb growth. Fluctuations between states of matter. Sudden onset metamorphosis. These reports are few and far between, but they cannot be ignored.

Our experiments with mutation are garnering some less than desirable results across our civilization. Perhaps unlocking the tools to modify one's genes at will was more than we initially bargained for.

label.zh: 不寻常的变异可以促进我们的研究。
label.en: Unusual mutations can boost our research.

tooltips.zh: §Y唯心主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
tooltips.en: §YSpiritualist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

tooltips.zh: 每位§Y威权主义£leader£领袖§!获得§Y求知若渴§!特质。
tooltips.en: Every §YAuthoritarian £leader£ Leader§! gains the §YEager§! Trait.

descriptions.zh:
由于自行进行变异实验，我们的一小部分人口发展出了非凡的能力和身体强化。

作为独特的强者和天赋者，他们正在形成一个群体，并引起了公众的广泛关注。
descriptions.en:
A small percentage of our population has developed extraordinary abilities and physical enhancements due to their own experiments with mutation.

As uniquely strong and gifted people, they are forming a community and garnering a lot of attention from the public.

label.zh: 他们的成功可能激励他人。
听起来他们会是优秀的士兵。
label.en: It sounds like they'd make good soldiers.

tooltips.zh: 在§Y[Owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!创建一支§Y基因战士部队§!。
tooltips.en: Creates a §YGene Warrior Army§! on §Y[Owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!.

tooltips.zh: §Y军国主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§G+50§!
tooltips.en: §YMilitarist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §G+50§!

label.zh: 找出他们是如何做到的并复制这一过程。
label.en: Find out how they did this and replicate it.

descriptions.zh:
监控确认了一群基因改造者居住在城市下水道系统的存在——这令人不安地印证了长期被忽视的都市传说。

这一发现加剧了社会紧张，随着对未知的恐惧升级，外表明显变异的公民报告遭受更多歧视。然而，这些个体展现出了非凡的创造力，以意想不到的方式利用下水道气体进行资源生产并改造他们的环境。
descriptions.en:
Surveillance has confirmed the existence of a population of genetically altered individuals inhabiting urban sewer systems - an unsettling echo of long-dismissed urban legends.

This discovery has heightened social tensions, with visibly mutated citizens reporting increased discrimination as fears of the unknown escalate. Nevertheless, these individuals have demonstrated remarkable ingenuity, harnessing sewer gases for resource production and adapting their environment in unexpected ways.

label.zh: 这些变异者可能发现了什么...
label.en: These mutants may be on to something...

descriptions.zh:
一种新疾病正在我们的帝国蔓延。这种疾病导致一系列令人不适的症状，包括但不限于：不自主的气体和液体排出、极度疲劳，某些情况下甚至会致命。

最奇特的是，这种疾病只影响那些通过基因变异改变了生理特征的人。对他们改造后基因组的持续研究带来了一些令人惊讶的发现。
descriptions.en:
An outbreak of a new disease is spreading across our empire. The illness causes a host of unpleasant symptoms, including but not limited to: involuntary expulsions of air and liquid, debilitating fatigue, and in some cases loss of life.

Most curiously, this disease is only affecting those who have altered their physiology in certain ways with genetic mutations. Ongoing study of their modified genome has led to some surprising insights.

tooltips.zh: §Y唯物主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
tooltips.en: §YMaterialist§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的基因组研究设施为整个文明提供了前所未有的生理改造能力。

然而，帝国的公民们想要更多。他们呼吁打破中央化的资源控制，允许所谓的"生物黑客"自由且不受限制地使用基因技术。
descriptions.en:
Our Genomic Research Facilities have granted our entire civilization access to physiological alteration unlike anything we have ever experienced.

However, the citizens of our empire want more. There are calls for breaking up centralized resources, and allowing so-called "biohackers" free and unrestricted access to gene technology.

label.zh: 给予生物黑客更多自主权。

tooltips.zh: §Y平等主义§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§G+50§!
tooltips.en: §YEgalitarian§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §G+50§!

label.zh: 普通公民已经拥有太多自由了。
label.en: The average citizen already has too much freedom.

descriptions.zh:
一位名为[event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName]的[Owner.GetScientist]刚刚发表了一篇学术研究，这项研究可能大大加快并提高我们基因实验的效率和效果。

这种新方法目前仅限于理论，尚未经过测试，因此要安全地应用到我们的工作中还需要仔细考虑其方法论。
descriptions.en:
A [Owner.GetScientist] by the name of [event_target:genius_geneticist.GetName] has just published a piece of academic research that could be used to dramatically accelerate and improve the efficiency and efficacy of our genetic experimentations.

Purely theoretical, the new method has not been tested, so the methodology will require some careful consideration in order to be applied safely to our processes.

label.zh: 轻率的想法——和个人——都不会被容忍。
label.en: Frivolous ideas - and individuals - will not be tolerated.

descriptions.zh:
由于我们持续的基因改造实验，我们的物种已被一段失控的基因代码侵入。我们正以惊人的速度变得虚弱，这段外来序列与我们自身基因物质的不受控制的相互作用正在破坏我们的稳定性。

我们必须在为时已晚之前解决这种异常的生物行为。
descriptions.en:
Our species has been infiltrated by a piece of rogue genetic code, a consequence of our persistent experimentation in genetic modification. We are becoming unwell at an alarming rate, destabilized by the unregulated interaction of this foreign sequence with our own genetic material.

We must address this anomalous biological behavior before it is too late.

descriptions.zh:
如果我们的文明要达到纯净，我们必须首先考虑[target.GetGestaltEntityName]的福祉。基因改造过程必须确保每一个适应性改变都能增强集体的韧性。

走错方向——引入导致不稳定或破坏凝聚力的改变——可能会是灾难性的，威胁到我们统一的根基。
descriptions.en:
If our civilization is to become pure, we must first consider the wellbeing of the [target.GetGestaltEntityName]. The genetic modification process must ensure that every adaptation enhances the collective's resilience.

Starting off on the wrong path - introducing changes that cause instability or undermine cohesion - could be disastrous, threatening the very foundation of our unity.

descriptions.zh:
为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。

只有通过仔细选择值得延续我们血统的工蜂，我们才能超越自然进化。
descriptions.en:
In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our species, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.

Only by carefully selecting the drones worthy of carrying on our lineage, can we transcend beyond natural evolution.

descriptions.zh:
为了确保我们物种的长久性和纯净性，我们必须实施更有选择性的繁育和更严格的基因筛查协议。

只有通过仔细选择拥有符合我们集体利益的特质的共生体，我们才能超越自然进化。
descriptions.en:
In order to ensure the longevity and purity of our symbiotic multitude, we must implement more selective breeding and stricter genetic screening protocols.

Only by carefully selecting viable symbionts with traits of interest to the collective can we transcend beyond our initial boundaries.

descriptions.zh:
基因修饰的回报将确保我们的传承，但每个[target.GetIndividualName]的角色、每分努力都必须与我们的纯净愿景保持一致。

我们现在面临一个重大抉择：是否要不惜牺牲适应能力来追求极致完美？还是应该采取更全面的策略，优先建设能够持续支撑这些努力的基础设施？
descriptions.en:
The rewards of genetic modification will secure our legacy, but every [target.GetIndividualName]'s role, every ounce of effort, must be aligned with our vision of purity.

We now face a critical decision: should we optimize for perfection at the cost of adaptability? Or should we embrace a broader strategy, prioritizing the infrastructure required to sustain these efforts?

label.zh: 追求纯净必须是我们唯一的焦点。
label.en: Becoming pure must be our only focus.

label.zh: 我们必须花时间发展基础。
label.en: We must take time to develop our infrastructure.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[target.GetGestaltEntityName]内部发现了一些基因杂质和异常。

在我们追求更大目标的过程中，必须消除这些缺陷特征，从自然进化手中夺回对我们身体发展的控制权。
descriptions.en:
We have isolated a number of genetic impurities and anomalies within the [target.GetGestaltEntityName].

As we strive towards our larger goals, we must eliminate these defective traits and take back control of our physical development from natural evolution.

label.en: Cull the weak to strengthen the whole.

tooltips.zh: §Y仁善倾向的§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
tooltips.en: §YBenevolence-inclined§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

label.zh: 重新改造有缺陷的个体。

descriptions.zh:
我们的克隆设施运转效率远超最初预期，导致现在出现了克隆体过剩的情况。

整合如此多的工蜂将是一个挑战。
descriptions.en:
Our cloning facilities are operating more efficiently than we initially expected, so we now have a clone surplus.

Integrating this many drones is proving challenging.

label.zh: 蜂巢的新成员应该被迁移。
label.en: New additions to the hive should be migrated.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一处主要克隆中心发生故障影响到了一些工蜂。克隆过程不知为何遭受到基因污染，导致长出了一批没有思考能力的克隆体。

它们本质上就是活着的物体，完全没有知觉，没有更高的认知功能。在完全找出原因、修正了这个生产问题之前，克隆设施的产出率暂时下降了。
descriptions.en:
Several drones have been affected following a malfunction at one of our primary Cloning centers. Genetic contaminants somehow entered the duplication process, leading to a batch of clones being grown without the capacity for thought.

They were essentially biological objects, completely non-sentient with no higher cognitive functions. Until the matter has been fully addressed, and the production problems mended, productivity at the facility is reduced.

tooltips.zh: §Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!上产生了100£pop£§H未开智人口§!。
tooltips.en: 100 £pop£ §HPresapient Pops§! is created on §Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们的意识内部浮现出了一个疑问：会不会有一天克隆体把我们都取代掉了？

我们在基因复制方面的初步努力进展顺利，使我们不禁好奇起这种高效的繁殖方法是否最终会取代我们的自然繁殖。

如果是这样，那么可能有一天蜂巢里再也没有原生子个体，只有克隆的克隆的克隆……这对我们这个物种究竟意味着什么呢？这个问题没有人知道答案，也让异常见蠢蠢欲动，但我们不得不问。
descriptions.en:
From within the consciousness, a question emerges: will clones one day replace us all?

Our initial efforts into genetic duplication are going well, so much so that we are curious if this efficient method of reproduction could eventually overtake our natural practice.

If so, then one day the hive may no longer contain any original donors, only clones of clones of clones... What does this mean for us as a species? A question without an answer, and one which breeds dissent. But we are compelled to ask.

label.zh: 这个问题本身是有价值的。
这种问题只会让我们分心。

descriptions.zh:
我们有了一项发现。通过操控特定基因，我们可以扩展意识的触及范围，使我们的感知能力超越物种原有的极限。

要在整个蜂巢范围内实施这些基因突变需要消耗大量能量，但这样做可能会加深我们对宇宙的理解，以及我们在其中所处位置的认知。
descriptions.en:
We have made a discovery. By manipulating specific genes, we can expand the reach of our consciousness to give us heightened senses beyond what we once thought of as the limits of our species.

Implementing these mutations hive-wide will require a great deal of energy, but doing so may deepen our understanding of the universe as well as our place within it.

label.zh: 这点代价微不足道。继续执行。

label.en: The process must not be rushed.

descriptions.zh:
蜂巢的多个区域正在经历无法控制的愤怒浪潮，这股情绪波动在共享意识中激起涟漪，放大了我们集体的痛苦与挫折。

最近引入的突变似乎过度刺激了工蜂攻击控制中枢的神经细胞，打破了蜂巢的情绪平衡。冲突事件愈发频繁，一些子个体甚至抛弃了原有任务，开始攻击其他同类。
descriptions.en:
Whole sections of the hive are experiencing surges of uncontrolled anger, a surge of emotion that has sent ripples through the shared consciousness, amplifying our collective pain and frustration.

A recently introduced mutation appears to be overstimulating neurocytes in our drones' aggression-control centers, disrupting the hive's emotional balance. Conflicts are erupting more frequently, with some drones abandoning their tasks and attacking others.

label.zh: 我们将齐心协力，保持清醒。
label.en: As one, we will be mindful.

descriptions.zh:
虽然某些突变确实让我们更强大和强化了我们，但我们发现其他突变却带来了不愉快的副作用。

虽然旨在延长寿命的强化已经成功实施，但这些相同的突变却降低了我们对极端气候的耐受性。

那些经历了这些生物强化的个体在调节体内温度系统时遇到了困难，这种不适感传遍了整个蜂巢。
descriptions.en:
While some mutations galvanize and enhance us, we are finding that others come with unpleasant side effects.

Enhancements aimed to increase our longevity are being implemented successfully, however these same mutations are lowering our tolerance for extreme climates.

Those of us who have undergone these biological augmentations are having difficulty regulating our internal thermoregulatory systems, and the discomfort is felt throughout the entire hive.

label.zh: 我们必须升级气候防护系统。
label.en: We must upgrade our weather protection systems.

label.zh: 随着我们的改变，我们对环境的偏好也在改变。
label.en: As we change, so do our environmental preferences.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了两种突变。一种变异能够增强基层子个体的力量，大幅提高劳动效率。另一种则能提升复杂型工蜂的智力，增强解决问题和战略思维的能力。

蜂巢必须决定选择哪条进化道路。
descriptions.en:
A pair of mutations has been identified. One variant enhances menial drones' strength, greatly improving labor efficiency. The other sharpens complex drones' intellect, boosting problem-solving and strategy.

The hive must decide which path to embrace.

descriptions.zh:
我们差点没控制住基因瘟疫的突然爆发。

我们对自己的生物学操控引发了基因突变，导致许多[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]的身体受到损害。

受影响的[target.GetIndividualNamePlural]已被隔离，现在必须决定如何继续前进。
descriptions.en:
We have barely contained the sudden outbreak of a genetic plague.

Manipulating our own biology has triggered rogue mutations in our DNA, leading to many [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] becoming physically compromised.

Affected [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] have been quarantined, and we must now decide how to move forward.

tooltips.zh: §Y仁善倾向的§!帝国对我们的评价改变：§R-50§!
tooltips.en: §YBenevolence-inclined§! empires' opinion of us changes by: §R-50§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量工蜂的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
descriptions.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to the degradation of genetic integrity in a substantial amount of our drones. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having reviewed the biological calculations involved in uplifting our species, and amended some potentially problematic procedures, we are ready to continue our efforts.

It is not yet certain however if we have actually rectified the error, or worse, introduced more blunders.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一个计算失误导致大量共生体的基因完整性发生退化。不幸的是，我们还不能确定失误是哪一步发生的。

在审查我们物种飞升所涉及的生物计算，并修正了一些可能存在问题的步骤后，我们打算继续推进工作。

然而我们仍然不能确定究竟是修正了问题还是带来了更多问题。
descriptions.en:
A misstep in our calculations has led to a degradation of genetic integrity in a significant number of our symbionts. Unfortunately we have not yet been able to identify at which point the misstep occurred.

Having reviewed the calculations involved in adapting our constituent parts, and having amended some imbalanced enzyme slurries, we are ready to continue our efforts.

It is not yet certain, however, if we have actually rectified the error - or worse, introduced more blunders.

label.zh: 我们可以从后果中吸取教训。
label.en: We can learn from whatever happens next.

tooltips.zh: §Y基因重塑§!局势进度在§Y12§!个月内：§R-50%§!
tooltips.en: §YBiomorphosis§! Situation progress speed for §Y12§! months: §R-50%§!

descriptions.zh: 在实施宏伟计划之前，我们需要把渗透进去的身躯安置在战略要地。之前集的情报收显示，人手不足的恒星和防御薄弱的行星是主要目标。很快我们就要开始工作了。
descriptions.en: Our infiltrated bodies will need to be placed in strategic locations before we can enact our grand design. Our earlier intel gathering revealed understaffed starbases and poorly defended planets as prime targets. Soon we will get to work.

descriptions.zh: 卑鄙的[From.GetName]渗透了我们的帝国。我们的空间站叛变，而他们已经在入侵我们的殖民地了。我们必须消灭冒名顶替者！
descriptions.en: The insidious [From.GetName] have infiltrated our empire. Our space stations are compromised and they are already invading our colonies. We must eliminate the imposters!

descriptions.zh:
我们起先以为是某种故障。我们的半数通讯网络都陷入瘫痪。

但不是的，奸诈的[From.GetName]悄悄替换了整个星域的关键人员。我们的帝国支离破碎，殖民地遭到入闽。

不要相信任何人！
descriptions.en:
First we thought it was a glitch. Half our communication network blacked out.

But no, the duplicitous [From.GetName] replaced entire sectors of key personnel. Our empire is fractured and our colonies are being invaded.

Do not trust anyone!

And do not worry about the truce you have with them. It is gone.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是§Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在§Y[target_planet.GetName]§!上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
descriptions.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the §Y[targetrivalname.GetName]§!.

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was ripe. Your colony on §Y[target_planet.GetName]§! - it is the ideal recipient. Its biosphere will be subsumed momentarily.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§!已经完成了对§Y[root.GetName]§!的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§! has completed its modifications on §Y[root.GetName]§!. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single chirp can operate an automatic door, and a swarm can incapacitate a factory. We are adapting by switching frequencies, but not all facilities will be returned to full efficiency.

descriptions.zh:

在整个星球上，那些曾经只知道吃草和泥浴的生物现在开始向我们提出关于存在本质的令人不安的问题。失落帝国改变了这个世界上大量野生动物的天性。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§! has completed its modifications on §Y[root.GetName]§!. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, creatures once content with grazing and mud baths now confront us with unsettling questions about existence. The Fallen Empire has tampered with large swathes of the world's fauna.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§!已经完成了对§Y[root.GetName]§!的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

这个世界在发光。字面意思的发光。这些改造不知何故让世界上各种物种都具有了生物荧光，并且不断发出类似引擎运转的嗡鸣声。我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]再也无法体验真正的昼夜循环了，我们需要为他们提供遮光设备。
descriptions.en:
The §Y[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]§! has completed its modifications on §Y[root.GetName]§!. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

The world is shining. Literally. The modifications have somehow provided the world's varied species with a bioluminescent glow and an incessant hum like that of a running engine. Our [owner.GetColonistPlural] no longer get to experience a true night cycle, we will need to provide them with blackout equipment.

descriptions.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]的审慎调查带领我们穿过层层叠叠的半石化生物质直至深深的地下。最终，我们传入了行星的中空内核——结果只发现每前进一步，令人压抑的大气都变得愈发沉重。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]有过心理预估，但这种愈发沉重不安令人无法人手。许多[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]发生了集体崩溃，陷入紧张症。这些人员必须立即撤离。

行星内部的巨大空洞并不是一般意义上的虚空。我们发现埋藏其中的是某些超出我们对生物体尺寸认知的东西。微弱羊膜残留迹象打消了一切疑虑。[From.Planet.GetName]并不是一颗荒芜的石头，它是一颗卵。

而其中，一颗胎死卵中的巨兽沉眠着。
descriptions.en:
Our cautious survey of [From.Planet.GetName] led us deep underground, through endless layers of semi-fossilized biological matter. At last, we breached the planet's hollow core - only to find the oppressive atmosphere growing heavier with every step. Despite [Root.GetLeaderName]'s precautions, the mounting unease proved unbearable. Several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] succumbed to a collective breakdown, collapsing into catatonia. They had to be evacuated immediately.

The vast cavern at the planet's heart is no ordinary void. Buried within, we found the remains of something far beyond the scale of any known lifeform. Faint traces of amniotic residue erased all doubt. [From.Planet.GetName] was never a barren rock. It is an egg.

And within, a stillborn monster sleeps.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
在[From.Planet.GetName]上，我们的[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]在这个胎死卵中的生物的头骨深处找到了一个奇怪的卷须网络。顺着这些有机细丝找到它们的来源，他们发现了突触簇的外部阵列——这是一个复杂的系统，仍然具有令人毛骨悚然的潜力。

现在，[Root.GetLeaderName]正试图利用沿着卷须跳动的古老电路与之交互。它脑内的知识应该存在得比它还久。至于它是否还记得，这还有待观察。
descriptions.en:
On [From.Planet.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] have traced a network of strange tendrils embedded deep within the skull of the stillborn creature. Following these organic filaments to their source, they uncovered an external array of synaptic clusters - an intricate system still thrumming with eerie potential.

Now, [Root.GetLeaderName] is attempting to interface with them, tapping into the ancient circuitry that pulses along the tendrils' length. Whatever knowledge it holds has long outlived its host. Whether it still remembers remains to be seen.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
这是十万年前的事。将蜂巢思维对时间的感知转换成星系标准单位是一个微妙的过程，但通过筛选生物计算机的记忆，[Root.GetLeaderName]逐渐拼凑出真相。

在这个蜂巢最强大的日子里，它面对着一个无法击败的敌人。虽然与许多盟友并肩作战，但每次都以失败告终。绝望中滋生出了鲁莽。

随后发生的大部分事情都被故意抹去了，但仍残留零散片段——足以让人瞥见他们最后的豪赌。蜂巢铸造了这颗行星大小的卵，作为他们飞升的容器，试图放弃他们脆弱的、被束缚在行星上的存在，并打算与孵化的幼崽融合。目前尚不清楚他们是打算战斗还是逃跑。

但是当这头生物动起来的时候，发生了可怕的事情。
descriptions.en:
It happened a hundred thousand years ago. Translating the Hive's perception of time into galactic standard units has been a delicate process, but by sifting through the biocomputer's memories, [Root.GetLeaderName] is beginning to piece together the truth.

At the height of its power, the Hive faced an enemy it could not defeat. Though it stood with many allies, every battle ended in failure. Desperation bred recklessness.

Much of what followed has been deliberately erased, but scattered fragments remain - enough to glimpse their final gamble. The Hive forged this planet-sized egg as the vessel for their ascension, seeking to abandon their frail, planet-bound existence and merge with the hatchling. Whether they intended to fight or flee is unclear.

But as the creature stirred, something went terribly wrong.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
通过精确地连接幸存的生物计算机和仍活跃的突触连接，我们从这个胎死卵中的生物中提取了最后的记忆。在巨大的认知压力下，这个过程迅速降低了生物计算机的性能，但我们也及时挽救了大部分数据。

面临着灭亡的威胁，这个蜂巢放弃了谨慎，将整个心灵倾注在未出生的宿主身上，绝望地为生存而努力。结果突触过载是致命的，注定了这个生物的灭亡，它并将蜂巢思维困在了一个痛苦的递归循环中。如果它最富有同情心的盟友没有切断这种联系，它可能会彻底灭亡。现在，它的思想只留下了破碎的回声，萦绕在[From.Planet.GetName]——一颗仍然被它最后的尖叫所困扰的星球上。

最后思绪很痛苦。
descriptions.en:
By precisely interfacing with the surviving biocomputers and their still-active synaptic link, we extracted the final memories from the stillborn creature. The process rapidly degraded the biocomputers under the immense cognitive strain, but we salvaged most of the data in time.

Faced with annihilation, the Hive abandoned caution, pouring its entire psyche into the unborn host in a desperate bid for survival. The synaptic overload proved fatal, dooming the creature and trapping the Hive in a recursive loop of excruciating agony. It would have perished entirely had its most compassionate ally not severed the link. Now, only shattered echoes of its mind remain, lingering on [From.Planet.GetName] - a world still haunted by its final scream.

The Last Thought is agony.
